name: Meor Ain
description: Meor Ain was a terrestrial planet in the Meor Ain system in the Jubilar sector of the Outer Rim Territories where Dex Acquisitions operated a depot. Tunga Arpagion was rescued from the depot by the Rebel Alliance.
